subject: Public Comment and Ethics Charter Provisions
overview: The committee concluded its review of Article 9, approving new requirements for public comment and standardizing conflict of interest language. Members also established a subcommittee to research financial disclosure rules for city officials before entering a July recess.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Article 9: Public Comment
items.summary: Approved adopting charter language requiring multi-member bodies to allow public comment on any matter within their jurisdiction, including a clause ensuring compliance with state privacy laws.

items.title: Article 9: Conflict of Interest
items.summary: Approved standard language requiring all city employees to comply with state conflict of interest laws while rejecting proposed local additions.

items.title: Ethics Reporting Subcommittee
items.summary: Established a subcommittee to research the feasibility of requiring elected officials and department heads to file annual statements of financial interest.

items.title: Property Naming and Land Taking
items.summary: Voted to exclude proposed charter sections regarding the naming of city property and the taking of land, opting to rely on existing state laws and local ordinances.

items.title: Final Report Planning and Schedule
items.summary: The committee organized a drafting group for the final report and confirmed the next full committee meeting for August 1, 2024.
